title: Orchestration AIOps2 — dispatcher Codex et gates d'intégration
body:
Parent tracking issue for PR #456.

- [ ] Review and integrate orchestration contract and AGENTS.md without clobbering concurrent audit commits.
- [ ] Configure **explicit Codex executor/dispatcher** if supported; until then do not claim ChatGPT schedules trigger Codex sessions.
- [ ] Register five role-specific GitHub issues and isolated writable branches/worktrees, with non-overlapping paths.
- [ ] Enforce exact-SHA CI, read-only Debian provenance, E2E gate and release approval; no auto-merge or production changes.

Stop conditions: no GLPI/PG writes, no Debian deployment, no new cron, no duplicate tickets, no HITL/Policy bypass. Ownership contract: docs/architecture/AIOPS2-MULTIAGENT-ORCHESTRATION.md on ops/aiops2-multiagent-orchestration-20261108.
